finding_1_target_svd_basis.target: Future cumulative increments Delta_Q(t) = Q(t) - Q(t0)
finding_1_target_svd_basis.dimension: Fitted per (phase, horizon, origin) on (N_train x T_quarters) matrix.
finding_1_target_svd_basis.audit_verdict: Mathematically sound for T <= 28 quarters, but basis is strictly bounded to the evaluation window.

finding_2_historical_trajectory_represen.finding: SVD basis represents future cumulative increments exclusively. Historical trajectory variation is NOT in the basis.
finding_2_historical_trajectory_represen.history_link: History enters solely via a 1D scalar feature: Q(t0) / mean(Q(t0)).
finding_2_historical_trajectory_represen.audit_verdict: All dynamic history (rate of decline, water-cut slope, GOR evolution) is discarded prior to origin.

finding_3_how_gp_generates_80_quarter_fo.finding: In audit_long_horizon.py:185-245, the GP model was NEVER EVALUATED for the 20-year forecast.
finding_3_how_gp_generates_80_quarter_fo.reality: The code initialized inc_tr = [] and never fit a GP. Instead, it substituted hard-coded parametric multipliers multiplied by an ad-hoc Gram-Schmidt synthetic basis.
finding_3_how_gp_generates_80_quarter_fo.audit_verdict: The reported 20-year forecast was 100% an imposed synthetic trajectory, not a learned surrogate prediction.

finding_4_connection_between_synthetic_a.finding: Zero mathematical connection exists between the synthetic polynomial basis (b1, b2, b3) and the learned SVD eigenvectors (Vt).
finding_4_connection_between_synthetic_a.audit_verdict: The synthetic basis was unconstrained orthogonal polynomials, which oscillate and produce artificial decreasing steps.

finding_5_coefficient_transfer_validity.finding: No projection tensor or basis transformation was applied. Coefficients were hard-coded heuristics (coeffs_c[0] = inc * 0.95, coeffs_c[1] = inc * 0.08 * (perm/5 - 1)).
finding_5_coefficient_transfer_validity.audit_verdict: Methodologically invalid. An actual surrogate model must predict valid coordinates in a continuous or rate-integrated basis.
